disclaimer: Rounded order-of-magnitude values for closed-form estimates only. Not manufacturer datasheets, not coupon-test results, and not a basis for certification. FDM printed-part strength varies with orientation, infill, temperature, and moisture.

records.name: PLA
records.printability_notes: FDM-printable hobby filament. Low warp; brittle relative to PETG/ABS. Poor high-temperature service.
records.source_note: REFERENCE ESTIMATE (ESTIMATED). Rounded typical FDM-printed PLA ranges from hobby/literature summaries, not a grade-specific datasheet. Do not treat as a tested or certified property set.

records.name: PETG
records.printability_notes: FDM-printable. Tougher and more heat-tolerant than PLA; stringing and moisture uptake are common.
records.source_note: REFERENCE ESTIMATE (ESTIMATED). Rounded typical FDM-printed PETG ranges, not a manufacturer specification. Printed coupons vary widely; not verified in this repository.

records.name: ABS
records.printability_notes: FDM-printable with an enclosed/warm chamber. Warp and fumes are common. Better temperature resistance than PLA.
records.source_note: REFERENCE ESTIMATE (ESTIMATED). Rounded typical FDM-printed ABS ranges, not a resin grade datasheet. Not a test-lab result.

records.name: Nylon
records.printability_notes: FDM-printable PA-class filament if kept dry. Strong warp tendency; properties change with absorbed moisture.
records.source_note: REFERENCE ESTIMATE (ESTIMATED). Coarse PA6/PA12 printed-part band only. Individual nylon grades differ a lot; this is not a precise manufacturer specification.

records.name: Aluminum 6061
records.printability_notes: Not FDM-printable. Included as a wrought-stock comparison only (typical 6061-T6 order of magnitude). ForgeX v1 manufacture remains fdm_3d_print.
typical_use_cases: Bought-item plates or standoffs outside the printed BOM
records.source_note: REFERENCE ESTIMATE (ESTIMATED). Rounded 6061-T6 handbook order-of-magnitude values, not a mill cert and not a measured bar. Cost is a coarse bulk-stock figure in USD/kg.

residential_records.name: C25/30 Concrete
residential_records.source_note: The C25/30 class designation expresses characteristic cylinder/cube strengths of 25/30 MPa. This is not a project-specific mix design or batch certificate. Density and local unit cost were not supplied in the catalog.

residential_records.name: Mortar
residential_records.source_note: Generic mortar record only. No mortar class, manufacturer, density, characteristic strength, or regional price was supplied.
